name: Hyuuga
source:
Commander of the 18th Empire fleet.

[spoiler]Hyuuga was adjutant of [url=/c813]Chitose's[/url] father. He is grateful to him for saving his life and the lives of the crew during the accident several years ago. He was the one who gave Chitose her stuffed animal, which was her father's last present to her.[/spoiler]
